test_title: PYST 42: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 25 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: The position(s) of how many letters will remain unchanged if each of the letters in the word NOTABLE is arranged in the English alphabetical order?
solution:
• Original Word: N O T A B L E 
 
• Letters in alphabetical order:A B E L N O T
 
• No, letters will remain unchanged

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
